# SheetMill

> SheetMill is a Go reference-sheet compiler. Its CLI, `smill`, validates GFM
> Markdown with YAML frontmatter, prints a versioned semantic JSON IR, converts
> Reference sheets with provenance, exports self-contained Hugo 0.167.0 projects
> and serves a read-only local preview. Nothing in a source sheet is executed or
> fetched. Typst/PDF and navi output are planned, not implemented.

Use this file to debug or investigate a SheetMill problem. To help a human set
up SheetMill or write sheets, read the agent guide instead. Contributors working
inside the repository must follow AGENTS.md.

Diagnostics are written to stderr as `path:line:column: CODE: message`; warnings
end with `(warning)`. Exit status: 0 success, 1 invalid source, 2 usage or IO
error (including broken stdout). `smill version` prints `smill dev` for source
builds. To investigate: reproduce with `smill check <file>`, then
`smill inspect <file>` to see how the parser understood the sheet (sections,
cards, IDs, attributes, byte spans), then `smill build hugo <file> --out <new-dir>`
for renderer issues. Report the exact command, input, stderr and exit status.

## Docs

- [Agent guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wstein/sheetmill/main/docs/agent-guide.md): setup, authoring rules and the check/inspect/build loop
- [CLI and diagnostic codes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wstein/sheetmill/main/docs/cli.md): commands, input selection, exit status and every code (SRC, FM, VAL, MD, ATTR, ID, IO, REN)
- [Source format](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wstein/sheetmill/main/docs/format/gfm-plus.md): frontmatter, sections, cards, heading attributes, IDs, spans and the JSON IR
- [Compatibility boundary](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wstein/sheetmill/main/docs/format/compatibility.md): what is and is not supported from other formats
- [Hugo export](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wstein/sheetmill/main/docs/hugo.md): project layout, URL safety, base path, link rewriting, Pages deployment
- [Reference import](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wstein/sheetmill/main/docs/imports.md): provenance flags, loss reports and IMP codes
- [Live preview security](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wstein/sheetmill/main/docs/studio-security.md): `smill serve` loopback, bootstrap and request rules
- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wstein/sheetmill/main/docs/architecture.md): pipeline and dependency choices

## Code map

- `cmd/smill`: executable entry point; all logic is in `internal/cli.Run`
- `internal/cli`: Cobra commands, input selection, symlink and size limits, output writing
- `internal/frontmatter`, `internal/validate`: YAML frontmatter decoding and metadata rules (FM, VAL codes)
- `internal/markdown`: GFM parsing into sections and cards, attributes and IDs (MD, ATTR, ID codes); golden JSON tests
- `internal/model`, `internal/diagnostic`: IR types and source spans
- `internal/importer/reference`: Reference conversion (IMP codes)
- `internal/render/hugo`: IR to Hugo project, URL safety and theme (REN codes)
- `internal/studio`: read-only local preview server
- `schema/cheatsheet.schema.json`: JSON Schema for decoded metadata

## Tests

- `go test ./...`, `go vet ./...` and `gofmt -l .` must pass; Go 1.27.2
- `SHEETMILL_HUGO=/absolute/path/to/hugo go test ./internal/render/hugo -run TestHugoIntegration` builds with real Hugo 0.167.0
- Golden IR changes: `go test ./internal/markdown -run TestGolden -update`, then inspect the diff
- [Browser E2E harness](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wstein/sheetmill/main/tests/e2e/README.md): pinned Hugo and Chromium reader journeys
